---
title: "Australian Equities: A Century of Outperformance"
date: "2010-08-15"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

Australian equities offered the highest return and second lowest risk of 19 major markets between 1900 and 2009, [according to Credit Suisse](http://www.marketwatch.com/story/the-worlds-best-stock-market-2010-08-12 "according to Credit Suisse").
